title: Gotrade Daily: After Nvidia, Retailers and Fed Minutes
summary: Nvidia beat third-quarter estimates. Tonight: Target and Lowe's before the open, Palo Alto after the close, then the Fed's October minutes.
body_markdown:
The stock jumped nearly 5% after the report, but the gain had narrowed to about 1.3% by 10:32 p.m. ET,[according to Investing.com](https://www.investing.com/news/stock-market-news/us-stock-futures-jump-as-nvidia-earnings-revive-ai-optimism-5034391) . More in[our Nvidia story](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/news/nvidia-nvda-stock-news-november-18-2026/) .


### Target and Lowe's before the open


**Target ([TGT](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/tgt/) )** , **Lowe's ([LOW](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/low/) )** and TJX report before the open,[according to CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/17/stock-market-today-live-updates.html) . EPS estimates for Target and Lowe's are $2.05 and $2.86,[according to Nasdaq's earnings calendar](https://www.nasdaq.com/market-activity/earnings) .


### Palo Alto after the close


**Palo Alto Networks ([PANW](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/us-stock/panw/) )** reports fiscal first-quarter 2027 results after the close, with a webcast at 1:30 p.m. PT,[according to the company](https://www.tradingview.com/news/prnewswire:b11a8d21cf3bb:0-palo-alto-networks-to-announce-fiscal-first-quarter-2027-financial-results-on-wednesday-november-18-2026/) . It guided non-GAAP EPS of $0.96 to $0.98,[according to its September release](https://www.paloaltonetworks.com/company/press/2026/palo-alto-networks-reports-fiscal-fourth-quarter-and-fiscal-year-2026-financial-results) .


## Pre-Market Pulse 📊


As of 10:32 p.m. ET on Tuesday, S&P 500 futures were up 0.2% at 7,372.20, Nasdaq 100 futures up 0.4% at 27,183.75 and Dow futures flat at 50,830, according to Investing.com.


## Macro Note 📝


The 10-year Treasury yield eased 2 basis points to 5.10% on Tuesday,[according to the US Treasury](https://home.treasury.gov/resource-center/data-chart-center/interest-rates/TextView?type=daily_treasury_yield_curve&field_tdr_date_value_month=202611) . Minutes of the Fed's October meeting come out Wednesday afternoon, with traders pricing a 96% chance of a December hike, according to CME FedWatch data cited by Investing.com.[Anthropic](https://www.heygotrade.com/en/news/anthropic-ipo-date-price-range-founder-control/) is expected to start trading Thursday,[according to CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/10/anthropic-sets-price-range-of-70-to-78-in-upcoming-ipo.html) .


## Conclusion


Tonight tests whether Nvidia's results can steady the market after the S&P 500 closed at its lowest level since July. Retail results come before the open, Palo Alto and the Fed minutes after the close.


US markets open at 9:30 a.m. ET.
